# dbus-sensors / utils_fuzzer

OSS-Fuzz's fuzz target `utils_fuzzer` ([source](source/utils_fuzzer.cpp), unmodified) over dbus-sensors (openbmc/dbus-sensors at b979de60).

FuzzedDataProvider-driven calls into dbus-sensors helpers: getDeviceBusAddr, escapePathForDbus, getPathForUnits, getPowerState/getPollRate/getPermitSet on a fuzzed config map, escapeName, splitFileName, findLimits, loadVariant<T> (exceptions swallowed with catch(...)), parseThresholdsFromConfig, sensorNameFind. Every result is (void)-discarded.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against dbus-sensors at commit b979de60.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.
